memory_candidates.content: To rewrite a HOLD task's description or hold_reason without resetting held_at, use one state-write.sh call with --arg bindings on the 713-style record ((.active_projects[] | select(.project_number == N)) |= (.description = $desc | .hold_reason = $hr | .last_updated = $ts)) and post-check status/prior_status/held_at with jq -e. update-task-status.sh preflight N hold --hold-reason=... resets held_at to today and must not be used for a reason-only rewrite.

When a task record cites artifacts of other tasks, cite them by the path they will have after /todo archival (specs/archive/{NNN}_{SLUG}/...) or by the argument's home document, and carry a line anchor verified with sed -n at write time. Live specs/{NNN}_ paths go stale the moment the owning task is archived; four such paths in one record were found stranded this way.
